items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Since we've mentioned (Achen?) and your marrying Marian...

ctx.x: Well Jimmy, I enjoyed it too. Because I liked to read anyway. But to be able to do something for Art you know, what can you do. Art was something.
Since we've mentioned (Achen?) and your marrying Marian (LAUGHTER) I think that it's probably as good a place as any to sort of talk about that. How you met her and....
